actions.body: The analysis of source-4bbf1d648a904340 and source-f2e47c3380ab4245 confirms that WAKE's architecture is explicitly designed to decouple the transient nature of individual model invocations from the durable, versioned state of the research process. The system leverages versioning and immutable evidence roots to ensure that while model state resets, the research continuity remains unbroken and auditable. This separation is fundamental to achieving the objective of an accountable, self-correcting inquiry process, as it mandates that all claims and revisions are grounded in historical evidence rather than current-context state. These findings resolve the outstanding commitments regarding the architectural assessment framework.
